notes: the marks every manor without a town carries in the MANORS view (owner 2026-09-13). kind hamlet: one farmstead per per_people of the manor's people (the ledger's, so they grow), at most max_count, clustered on the manor's SITE (MapObjects.manor_site: by a river or road, back from the coast, down from the heights, or the centre of a plain); kind focus: marks of the chief good worked (focus_code, data/manor_focus.csv), by per_people too, laid around the farmsteads and never over them. aspect is the art's width over its height (for the overlap test); height_px in terrain_art.csv units (x map_decor_scale) — a farmstead stays smaller than a village drawing; flip 1 lets a mark mirror, rotate_deg how far it may turn either way; min_scale the zoom the row appears at
